topic: Smart Beta, Quant Funds and other Non-Traditional Index Funds
source_evidence: Because non-traditional index funds may be less correlated to the market, you may want to consider investing in them together with other types of funds.
answer: Market correlation describes how similarly an investment may behave to the broader market. Non-traditional index funds may behave differently from the market and traditional index funds. Depending on their characteristics, holding them alongside other types of funds may help smooth out volatility and decrease risk. However, owning different funds does not automatically ensure diversification: their indexes may contain the same securities or assign larger-than-expected weights to some holdings. Looking through the index to a fund’s actual holdings can help you assess whether it adds diversity.
